Episode three of The 9/11 Files, titled They Could Have Stopped It, lays out the warnings that came before the attacks. Tucker Carlson argues that signals about the hijackers reached officials and were ignored or blocked. The host builds the case as a damning hour of missed chances.

The chapter walks through the memos, watchlist failures, and rivalry between agencies that let the plot slip through. Carlson names the moments when a different choice might have stopped the planes. He asks why no one in power paid for the failure. Questioning and angry viewers get the strongest chapter of his series.
